target.title: fix(deepgram): validate realtime base URL overrides, preserving ws(s):// endpoints
target.body:
<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a malformed Deepgram `baseUrl` in provider config crashes realtime
transcription session setup with an uncaught `TypeError: Invalid URL`, while an unrelated scheme
(e.g. `ftp:`) is silently accepted and rewritten into an unusable endpoint.

`normalizeDeepgramRealtimeBaseUrl` in `extensions/deepgram/realtime-transcription-provider.ts`
only trimmed the value — it never confirmed the result was a usable URL. Its consumer
`toDeepgramRealtimeWsUrl` does `new URL(normalizeDeepgramRealtimeBaseUrl(config.baseUrl))` and then
rewrites the protocol for the WebSocket connection.

**Concrete example:** with `baseUrl: "not a url"`, `normalizeDeepgramRealtimeBaseUrl` on current
`main` returns `"not a url"` and the downstream `new URL("not a url")` throws an opaque
`TypeError: Invalid URL` at session setup. A value like `ftp://host` parses but is not a usable
Deepgram endpoint, yet is accepted and rewritten.

## Why This Change Was Made

Validate the base URL at the normalizer boundary and **fail actionably**: only an absent/blank value
(or unset `DEEPGRAM_BASE_URL`) falls back to the default endpoint; an explicit value that is
unparseable, or whose scheme is none of `http:`/`https:`/`ws:`/`wss:`, throws a clear
`Invalid Deepgram baseUrl` error. This mirrors the sibling ElevenLabs fix (#105163).

The allowlist intentionally includes the WebSocket schemes: the released provider (`v2026.6.11`)
passes a direct `ws://`/`wss://` override straight through to `toDeepgramRealtimeWsUrl`, and Deepgram
realtime streaming itself is WSS — so custom proxies legitimately configure a `wss://` endpoint.
`toDeepgramRealtimeWsUrl` now preserves an explicit `ws:`/`wss:` scheme (only `http:`/`https:` are
mapped to their WebSocket equivalents), keeping that released behavior intact. Validation errors are
redacted — they never echo the raw configured URL, so embedded userinfo or credential-bearing query
params are not disclosed to logs/diagnostics.

## User Impact

**Before:** a mistyped Deepgram `baseUrl` surfaces an opaque `TypeError: Invalid URL` at session
setup; an unrelated scheme is accepted and produces an unusable endpoint.

**After:** an explicit malformed or unrelated-scheme `baseUrl` fails fast with an actionable,
secret-safe error; absent/blank config still defaults; valid `http(s)://` and direct `ws(s)://`
endpoints (including custom path/port) are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `extensions/deepgram/realtime-transcription-provider.ts` — `normalizeDeepgramRealtimeBaseUrl` accepts `http/https/ws/wss`, rejects unparseable and unrelated-scheme values (throws), and only defaults absent/blank input; error messages surface only "value is not a valid URL" or the offending `protocol`, never the raw URL. `toDeepgramRealtimeWsUrl` preserves a direct `ws:`/`wss:` scheme. Exposed via the existing `testing` object for coverage.
- Regression test: `extensions/deepgram/realtime-transcription-provider.test.ts` — asserts absent/blank → default, valid `http(s)` → normalized, direct `wss://` and `ws://` → preserved, custom path + port on a `wss://` override → preserved through the URL builder, explicit malformed → throws, `ftp:` → throws `unsupported scheme`, and a `baseUrl` with userinfo + `api_key` query is rejected without its secret appearing in the error. These fail on the pre-fix trim-only version.
- Function probe against the real production helpers (via `testing`):

```
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./extensions/deepgram/realtime-transcription-provider.ts').then(m => …)"
--- direct wss:// override (released behavior) ---
normalize: wss://api.deepgram.com/v1
wsUrl    : wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen
--- wss:// custom proxy w/ path + port ---
wsUrl    : wss://proxy.example.com:9090/dg/v1/listen
--- http(s):// still mapped ---
https -> wss://custom.example.com/listen
http  -> ws://localhost:8080/listen
--- malformed + unrelated scheme still rejected (redacted) ---
"not a url"               -> THROWS: Invalid Deepgram baseUrl: value is not a valid URL
"ftp://files.example.com" -> THROWS: Invalid Deepgram baseUrl: unsupported scheme "ftp:" (expected http, https, ws, or wss)
```

(The credential-bearing `ftp://user:sup3r-secret@…?api_key=leak-me` input is rejected with no `sup3r-secret` / `leak-me` / `api_key` in the message.)
